coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Potrero Power Station Block 3
record.summary: Planned office/laboratory block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan with a flat 130 ft height limit; residential uses are not permitted here; no design review approval or construction start found.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- this block is not yet built (no design-review approval or construction start found; it is not in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list) and no Assessor lot of its own was found: DataSF Parcels (checked 2026-09-29) shows its footprint lying within a much larger active lot, 4175028 (1241 Delaware St, about 21,900 sq m, recorded 2022-08-30), which also overlaps the Block 4 and Block 9 footprints. Traced from an adopted regulatory diagram via multi-point real-street georeferencing (see digitization_method), but this diagram is dated 2020 and may not reflect later design changes. Treat vertex positions as accurate to roughly 10-25m, not survey-grade. West edge corrected 2026-09-16 (fifth pass) against Maryland Street's real, directly-measured near curb, cross-validated against the source diagram's own printed scale (which independently implies a similar block width) -- treat that edge as accurate to roughly 5-10m. The north, south, and east edges still carry the original 10-25m diagram-transform tolerance and have not been independently re-verified against satellite imagery. Rebuilt 2026-09-16 via GDAL GCP/TPS georeferencing -- see digitization_method. Re-measured 2026-09-16 (third pass) in a single consistent pixel-detection pass across the whole block layout -- see digitization_method. Re-corrected 2026-09-16 (fourth pass) after fixing a mis-measured GCP -- see digitization_method.
notes.digitized_from: Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final (February 26, 2020), Figure 6.2.3 - Building Height Plan (printed p.245, PDF p.247).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor parcel may exist under this block (part of the site's larger, largely unaddressed footprint), but it has not been subdivided per the masterplan's individual named blocks -- this uses hand-traced approximate geometry instead. DataSF Parcels (checked 2026-09-29) shows this footprint within the much larger active lot 4175028 (1241 Delaware St), not a lot of its own.
notes.regulatory_context: Flat 130 ft max height per Figure 6.2.3 of the final D4D (colour-coded height label). The D4D's Permitted Uses table (Table 3.1.1) marks Residential Not Permitted on this block, while Non-Retail Sales/Services (office), Laboratory and Life Science uses are permitted (subject to the table's note 13) -- i.e., planned as an office/lab block, not residential. In Figure 6.2.3 the block sits north of Humboldt Street between Maryland and Delaware Streets, so it does not front the Louisiana Paseo (which runs between Blocks 15 and 7). No construction-start source found.

facts.value: Non-Retail Sales/Services (office) and Laboratory/Life Science uses permitted; Residential Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)
flat 130 ft max per the D4D's Figure 6.2.3

As adopted in the D4D (Table 3.1.1, note 13), one or more of Blocks 2, 3, 11, 12 or 15 had to be deed-restricted for Life Science/Laboratory uses under the Development Agreement's Phasing Plan; on July 28, 2022 the Planning Commission (Resolution No. 21156) approved deleting the Phasing Plan section that required one building of not less than 130,000 sq ft to be dedicated to Life Science uses, so that requirement was removed. Laboratory and Life Science uses remain permitted here.
Not listed among the six Phase 1 blocks (2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) named in the 2024 annual compliance report

changes.text: Block 3's expected completion is now 2031, from SocketSite's October 2020 schedule table (Phase 2, vertical development 2029-2031), instead of the 2035 whole-project target. The life-science deed-restriction fact now says the Planning Commission's Resolution 21156 (July 28, 2022) removed the requirement to dedicate a 130,000 sq ft building to life science. The mapping notes no longer call the site vacant land with no address: DataSF Parcels shows the footprint within the much larger active lot 4175028 (1241 Delaware St). The unsourced 'secondhand description' contrast was removed, mapping sources now cite the final D4D (Feb 26, 2020) instead of a dead 2019 draft link, and the D4D publisher is shown as SF Planning.

Block 3's 2029-2031 window comes from a 2020 press table (SocketSite); no current Block 3 schedule was found.
